page.layout: One printed page. Top: page number at upper left, running head "EMBLEMA" centred above the title. Title in capitals and italic across two lines. Centre: engraving (emblem picture) with no text inside it. Below the engraving: four lines of italic verse, centred. Bottom right: catchword "SVPER-".

main_text.head: CVRRVS SVPERBIÆ TRAhitur adinferos.
main_text.p: [engraving: emblem picture of devils leading a chariot carrying a proud figure, with a flag and fire behind; no printed text inside it]
main_text.l: De cunctis populis plebe furente manum.
Verum (eheu!) pleno vehitur sub tartara curru,

page.notes: The engraving has no printed text. The title's line-end hyphen after "TRA-" is printed and kept in the heading as "TRA-hitur" split across lines. The running head is taken as "EMBLEMA" from the top centre. Verse lines are set with indents, reproduced as lines.
